author: Shri Raghavendra Swami
commentary: श्रमानापादकचेष्टानुक्तस्य युक्तस्वप्नावबोधस्य यावन्निद्राऽवबोधौ योगाविघातकौ तावन्निद्रावबोधोपेतस्य योगो ध्यानयोगः समाधिरितियावत् ।  दुःखहा भवतीत्यर्थः
translation: V. In 16 the prohibition regarding food and vigils refers to persons who are naturally weak. In the case of those who are endowed with powers of endurance and absolute abstinence wakefulness, &c., cannot interfere with the course of meditation. .. ..
